content:
According to a series of leaks, the market has already reached a clear consensus on two of the three expected colors for the iPhone 18 Pro, which is set to be unveiled next week.

However, two well-known leakers have differing views on whether the third color will be silver or black...

All leaks so far have aligned on two of the expected colors, although the exact shade of purple remains somewhat uncertain:

  • Deep cherry/wine red
  • Sky blue

However, reports have been contradictory on whether the third color is silver or black, and two highly prominent leakers are on opposite sides of this debate.

Black...

Fixed Focus Digital stated yesterday that the third color will be black, and that silver will "most likely" not be part of this color lineup. Fans supporting silver can rest easy, because the sky blue is very likely the same extremely pale blue used on the iPhone Air and MacBook Air, which actually looks more like silver under most lighting conditions.

If this is true, many people will be very pleased, since quite a few were disappointed that the iPhone 17 Pro series lacked a black or space gray option.

...or silver

However, Sonny Dickson, without directly refuting this claim, responded by posting a photo purportedly showing SIM card trays in three colors, with the third one being silver. He had previously shared images including a black version, but now says he hasn't seen any trace of black in recent months.

Which one are you hoping for?

Which side do you want to be right? Please take our poll and share your views in the comments section.
